## UnixNanos

[Source](https://github.com/chalk-ai/chalk-router-oss/blob/main/src/handlers/traces.rs#L75). Nanoseconds since the unix epoch. Accepts a JSON number or a decimal string (JS callers should send strings: ns values exceed 2^53).
